bio: Anthony Foxx is an accomplished business and public policy leader. He is the Emma Bloomberg Professor of the Practice of Public Leadership and Director, Center for Public Leadership at the Harvard Kennedy School. Anthony served as the 17th U.S. Secretary of Transportation (2013-2017), receiving a rare unanimous confirmation (100-0) by the U.S. Senate. After more than a decade of short-term transportation funding bills, Anthony successfully pushed for passage of new long-term legislation, the FAST Act.
